t: LIVELY Reviews 2026 - Read Before You Buy | Thingtesting
s: LIVELY earns mixed reviews: the brand delivers comfortable, cute basics—especially bralettes, T-shirt bras, and nursing styles—but durability, sizing accuracy, and support for larger cups undermine the experience. Reviews praise soft fabrics, versatile cross-back/J-hook details, and wire-free ease, while citing strapless discomfort, materials that pill or stretch, slipping straps, and a “busty” range that tops out at DDD and fits inconsistently.
